working_tree_semantics: Round 2 was implemented and verified in the current uncommitted worktree. Existing user documentation changes were preserved. This evidence does not claim a later Git checkpoint and no files were staged, committed, or pushed.

product_contract.physical_stream_source: PIPE or PTY reader -> single incremental sanitizer -> bounded TerminalOutputOwner
product_contract.tool_result_live_semantics: provisional Start/Delta while the process is running; one authoritative End replaces the same block with the Round 1 canonical preview
product_contract.cursor_semantics: exact same-process cursor and delta; retention loss returns typed GAP
product_contract.foreground_cwd: advances only after physical completion to an existing workspace-contained final cwd
product_contract.yielded_cwd: never advances the Terminal session cwd

monitor_and_canonical_contract.monitor_owner: process-local TerminalMonitorCoordinator in the current Host
monitor_and_canonical_contract.provider_wire_role: user with a fixed untrusted-terminal-output boundary and no human provenance
canonical_acceptance_transaction: active-turn safe predicate or idle revision-0 turn genesis
monitor_and_canonical_contract.idle_turn_genesis: turn, revision-0 binding, initial entry, and event are installed atomically
monitor_and_canonical_contract.turn_initial_entry_id: NOT NULL with deferred same-session, same-turn, scope, and kind validation

environment_and_physical_close.shell_probe: bounded login-shell process-group probe with sentinel, 1 MiB cap, timeout, single-flight, startup-file signature, TTL, and typed fallback
environment_and_physical_close.default_environment: inert-only exact allowlist with secret-shaped name/value defense
environment_and_physical_close.host_close_order: stop monitor admission, terminate process groups, join reader/watcher/process owners, then release tool, repository, provider, and Host resources

closed_contracts: cursor-selected artifact candidate uses the exact selected source range
process completion and capacity retirement wait for the entire process group
monitor successor installation revalidates the frozen evaluation generation
login-shell probe close linearizes SPAWNING, RUNNING, and JOINED
PTY close_stdin sends EOT or returns a typed failure
SUBAGENT_TASK scope cannot list, register, or cancel ROOT monitors
normal monitor rejection lowers to a typed REJECTED result
sanitizer-unavailable output cannot claim COMPLETE source coverage
terminal completion preserves exact ROOT or SUBAGENT_TASK origin
terminal and terminal_process.wait use watcher-owned physical completion instead of shell-leader wait
process admission linearizes live plus launching capacity under the registry lock
sanitizer failure persists TERMINAL_SANITIZER_UNAVAILABLE instead of retention eviction
malformed terminal_monitor input uses the common INVALID_ARGUMENTS descriptor contract

real_provider_dogfood.configuration: real configured OpenAI-compatible provider; 1024-token output cap; one-shot empty HOME; MCP discovery replaced with an empty tuple only inside the dogfood process
real_provider_dogfood.database: fresh clean-v0 ephemeral database, force-dropped after verification

production_diff.counting_scope: tracked diff under src and clients plus four untracked Round 2 production modules

non_goals: cross-Host process, cursor, monitor, or autonomous-continuation recovery
durable raw Terminal output or monitor notification history
recovery of process bytes already removed by the retained-output bound
active capability environment inheritance by default
Git, SSH, proxy, or another specialized environment grant mechanism
advanced Go Terminal process viewer or monitor dashboard
